mission: Observe the direct packaged CoreCLR craft-868x host, capture terrain/water, and perform a bounded ordinary movement check.
neutral_observation: The initial original is a dark slate/blank viewport with only the upper-left Rusty CraftSurvive debug/control panel visible; no terrain or water is visible. After a 15-second settle interval, the original shows blue foreground and channel water, grassy dirt voxel banks on both sides, bright sky/clouds, and the same panel. After one 800 ms W hold, the original remains visually near-identical at this framing. The initial blank state followed by delayed terrain rendering is recorded as an unexpected observation.
acceptance_mapping: The direct packaged host ultimately rendered the requested terrain/water scene with no page errors. W input was attempted through the ordinary path; the before/after images do not establish a visible movement effect, so none is claimed.
actions: Started the supplied craft-868x profile through crew-services playtest CLI.
Captured the initial original, which was blank behind the debug panel.
Waited 15 seconds and captured the rendered water/terrain scene.
Held virtual key W (87) for 800 ms and captured a post-input original.

browser_observation.title: Rusty CraftSurvive
console_warnings: WebGL GPU stall due to ReadPixels (repeated; final capture says this message will no longer repeat)
